claim.quote: It was the billboard and the TV that actually warmed them up at the top of funnel but these got no attribution.
claim.text: The source gives an example where a billboard and TV ad warm a buyer, but a later Facebook ad is credited; the Facebook ad probably did not cause the purchase and the top-of-funnel touchpoints got no attribution.

unit.title: Multi-touch journey can leave top-of-funnel unattributed
